name: TaskerHA
tagline: A Tasker plugin to fully integrate Home Assistant into your workflow
blurb: TaskerHA is a Tasker plugin that connects Tasker to Home Assistant.
description:
TaskerHA is a Tasker plugin that connects Tasker to Home Assistant.

Features:
• Respond to entity state changes
• Call any Home Assistant service
• Retrieve an entity's state
• Full integration with Tasker variables

Requires:
• Tasker
• Home Assistant instance with a long-lived access token
